
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- stm32_basic.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip stm32f103` to volt.toml: chip = "stm32f103"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip stm32f103
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- stm32_basic.volt:4[/yellow bold]

GPIO 13 is a JTAG pin. Using it disables JTAG debugging.

 [dim]3 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin led: Output = 13
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^[/yellow]
